exceptions.reason: These unresolved advisories concern Chroma HTTP server collection/configuration endpoints and server RBAC. This application never starts a Chroma HTTP server: it uses only embedded PersistentClient with embedding_function=None and server-owned collection names/configuration. The public deployment uses VECTOR_STORE=memory. This exception does not authorize exposing Chroma as a service or accepting user-supplied embedding functions; review before changing that architecture. See SECURITY.md.
